headline: Moves the compliance date for ceiling fan light kit energy standards from January 7, 2019 to January 21, 2020, matching the date for ceiling fans.
what_it_does: This law changes one deadline in federal energy conservation rules. Manufacturers must meet the amended efficiency standards for ceiling fan light kits by January 21, 2020 instead of January 7, 2019. That makes the light kit deadline the same as the deadline for ceiling fans themselves.

who_it_affects.group: Manufacturers of ceiling fans and ceiling fan light kits
who_it_affects.how: They get until January 21, 2020 instead of January 7, 2019 to make their light kits meet the amended federal energy efficiency standards.

who_it_affects.group: Retailers that sell ceiling fans and light kits
who_it_affects.how: Products they sell must meet the amended standards on the new, later date, so the timing of stock changes shifts accordingly.

when_it_takes_effect: The new compliance date of January 21, 2020 applies, and the law was enacted April 3, 2018.
